schema.name: valid hooks
schema.yaml:
hooks:
  - id: idle-notify
    event: session.idle
    actions:
      - notify: "Agent is idle"
  - id: guard-bash
    event: tool.before.bash
    action: stop
    actions:
      - bash: "./scripts/check.sh"
        timeout: 5000

schema.name: all action forms
conditions
schema.yaml:
hooks:
  - id: cond
    event: file.changed
    conditions:
      - matchesCodeFiles
      - matchesAnyPath: "src/**/*.ts"
      - matchesAllPaths:
          - "src/**"
          - "**/*.ts"
    actions:
      - bash: "echo changed"
  - event: session.idle
    conditions: []
    actions:
      - bash: x
  - event: tool.after.*
    conditions: [matchesCodeFiles]
    actions:
      - bash: y

schema.name: async forms
schema.yaml:
hooks:
  - event: tool.after.write
    async: true
    actions:
      - bash: a
  - event: file.changed
    async: {group: " uploads ", concurrency: 2}
    actions:
      - bash: b
  - event: session.created
    async: false
    actions:
      - bash: c
  - event: session.deleted
    async: {}
    actions:
      - bash: d
  - event: file.changed
    async: {group: uploads, concurrency: 2}
    actions:
      - bash: e

runtime.name: async hooks
runtime.yaml:
hooks:
  - id: upload

    async: true
    actions:
      - bash: upload
      - bash: upload-2
  - id: grouped

    async: {group: g, concurrency: 2}
    actions:
      - bash: grouped
  - id: failing
    event: tool.after.*
    async: true
    actions:
      - bash: async-throw
      - bash: never
  - id: sync
    event: tool.after.write
    actions:
      - bash: sync
